perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.desc:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Chambered Compensator
perks.desc:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Barrel
perks.desc:
Weighty barrel extension.
  •  Increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed
  •  Moderately controls recoil

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.desc:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Full Bore
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for distance.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases stability
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Hammer-Forged Rifling
perks.desc:
Durable ranged barrel.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Polygonal Rifling
perks.desc:
Barrel optimized for recoil reduction.
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Accelerated Coils
perks.desc:
Speeds up charge.
  •  Faster charge time
  •  Decreases impact damage

perks.name: Enhanced Battery
perks.desc:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Ionized Battery
perks.desc:
Large heavy battery.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed

perks.name: Liquid Coils
perks.desc:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

perks.name: Particle Repeater
perks.desc:
Improves stability. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Projection Fuse
perks.desc:
Distance optimizations.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Triple Tap
perks.desc: Rapidly landing precision hits will return one round to the magazine.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.desc: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Reservoir Burst
perks.desc: When the battery is full, your next burst deals additional damage and causes enemies to explode on death.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.desc: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Withering Gaze
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon for a short period of time without firing grants the ability to weaken the next target. Timer resets after firing or when you stop aiming down sights.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Willing Vessel
perks.desc: Dealing damage or defeating targets with this weapon gradually grants increased stability, handling, reload speed, and charge rate. This effect gradually decreases over time but is gained more quickly while near allies.

perks.name: Runneth Over
perks.desc: Reloading near allies overflows the magazine. Bows receive faster draw time and Swords receive faster charge rate.
